item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"`dspy.Evaluate.__call__` runs the devset through `ParallelExecutor.execute` and replaces each `None` result with `(dspy.Prediction(), self.failure_score)` before building the per-example `(example, prediction, score)` results list.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"After that substitution, `dspy.Evaluate.__call__` sums the per-example scores and returns `EvaluationResult(score=..., results=...)`, so failed items still contribute a fallback score to a completed evaluation result.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"`Module.batch` is the wrapper path for failure details: it accepts `return_failed_examples`, constructs `Parallel` with that flag, and returns `(results, failed_examples, exceptions)` when the flag is true, but only `results` when it is false.","span_ids":["s3","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`Parallel` provides the direct failure-reporting path: `return_failed_examples` is a constructor option stored on the instance, and `forward` uses `executor.failed_indices` plus `executor.exceptions_map` to return the original failed examples and exception objects alongside `results`.","span_ids":["s5","s6","s7"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/evaluate/evaluate.py","start_line":162,"end_line":182},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/evaluate/evaluate.py","start_line":223,"end_line":226},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":269,"end_line":296},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/primitives/module.py","start_line":297,"end_line":317},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/predict/parallel.py","start_line":10,"end_line":19},{"span_id":"s6","path":"dspy/predict/parallel.py","start_line":61,"end_line":66},{"span_id":"s7","path":"dspy/predict/parallel.py","start_line":110,"end_line":124}]}
